entities.name: Faeries
entities.description: A creature type of human-like, magical, trick-loving beings found across the multiverse, often small and winged.

entities.name: Oona
entities.description: The enigmatic Queen of the Fae on Lorwyn-Shadowmoor, a flower-like ur-faerie from whom all faeries originally came.

entities.name: Maralen
entities.description: The faerie who becomes the new great faerie ruling from Glen Elendra after Oona's defeat.

entities.name: Talion
entities.description: The ruler of Eldraine's High Fae.

entities.name: High Fae
entities.description: Eldraine's ancient, wooden-bodied fae nobles, ruled by Talion, who follow strict rules of gifts, promises and truth.

entities.name: Rankle
entities.description: A black-aligned prankster fae famous for his pranks.

entities.name: Eldraine
entities.description: A plane where the fae of the Wilds oppose the five knightly courts.

entities.name: Lorwyn-Shadowmoor
entities.description: A plane whose faeries are ubiquitous and mysterious, led by Oona.

entities.name: Tuinvale
entities.description: A place deep in the Wilds where most High Fae remain secluded.

entities.name: Glen Elendra
entities.description: The place from which Maralen rules and stewards the plane.

entities.name: Kieryn elves
entities.description: Elves who summoned fire sprites against the Calthyn elves.

entities.name: Calthyn elves
entities.description: Elves opposed by the Kieryn elves in the White Woods of Corondor.

entities.name: Great Aurora
entities.description: A Lorwyn event that largely did not affect the faeries.

entities.name: Autumn Willow
entities.description: A being of Ulgrotha's Great Wood who created a faerie noble in the form of Veldrane of Sengir.

entities.name: Veldrane of Sengir
entities.description: A faerie noble created by the Autumn Willow.

entities.name: Ulgrotha
entities.description: A plane whose Great Wood is home to faerie nobles.

entities.name: Izzet League
entities.description: A Ravnican guild that uses ratchet faeries to repair devices and carry messages.

events.summary: Fire sprites are summoned by the Kieryn elves while fighting the Calthyn elves in the White Woods of Corondor.
events.quote: They were summoned by the Kieryn elves while fighting against the Calthyn elves in the White Woods of Corondor .

events.summary: During the Ice Age faeries become among the few creatures to grow more powerful.
events.quote: During the Ice Age , faeries were among the few creatures to become even more powerful .

events.summary: The faeries of Lorwyn are largely unaffected by the Great Aurora, though Oona's consolidation of power leads some to branch into white.
events.quote: The faeries of Lorwyn were the only tribe to be largely unaffected by the Great Aurora

events.summary: After Oona's defeat, Maralen becomes the new great faerie who rules from Glen Elendra.
events.quote: After Oona's defeat, Maralen became the new great faerie who rules from Glen Elendra and stewards the plane.

events.summary: The Autumn Willow creates the faerie noble Veldrane of Sengir, and the nobles take over the River Bridge in the Great Wood.
events.quote: The Autumn Willow created one of them in the form of Veldrane of Sengir .
